svg.title: Kurly Data Platform: Data Flow & AX Direction
svg.desc: Six left-to-right swimlanes show AWS data sources, CDC ingestion, Kafka streaming, GCP BigQuery warehouse, consumers, and a dashed future AX platform. Solid paths are supported by Kurly technology blog posts; dashed paths are proposed or inferred.

text.tspan: Kurly Data Platform: Data Flow & AX Direction
Publicly documented data flow and a clearly marked AX target state
Orchestration: Airflow on Kubernetes (EKS, Helm, CeleryExecutor)
Cross-cutting capability; 2023 BigQuery MERGE was orchestrated by GCP Cloud Composer
Source basis: Kurly tech blog (2023–2024) · dashed paths are not a claim of current deployment
